The project in order, from a battery and two wires to a call between two
machines.

Each milestone is a state the repository can be read in — not a feature set. If
you cloned it at any one of them, the thing would build, run, and make exactly
the claims it had by then earned.

The sequence is deliberate in two respects. **Every check is written before the
apparatus it judges**, and lands expected to fail; the dependencies below
enforce it. And **nothing is judged against a figure nobody can trace**: the
first piece of work in the project is the ledger of published figures, in
`docs/sources.md`, and every check cites it.

The two claims the whole roadmap serves are in `CLAUDE.md` — a phone number is a
set of directions; phreaking has no code — and every item labelled `thesis`
exists to make one of them true or to catch it becoming false. How the team
works the roadmap is in `AGENTS.md`.

    cairn list --view next          what is ready to work on now
    cairn list --view decisions     what only the owner can settle
    cairn list --view thesis        the items the project exists for
    cairn list --view honesty       admissions owed: what is not modelled
